channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: Ladybirds’ Dobbins top defensive player in girls flag football
item.description: Southern Nash’s Noel Dobbins was named top defensive player as the Ladybirds dominated the inaugural girls flag football season, reaching the state quarterfinals and placing four players on the all-conference team.

item.title: Sheriff Woodard says he will not run in 2026
item.description: Wilson County Sheriff Calvin Woodard Jr. will not seek a fifth term after 16 years of service, highlighting his office’s progress and endorsing Maj. Brandon Barbrey as a candidate to continue his legacy.

item.title: UPDATE: Garage fire damage estimated at $4.2M
item.description: A fire at the Wilson County Schools bus maintenance garage caused an estimated $4.2 million in damage Sunday. No injuries were reported, and the cause of the fire remains undetermined.

item.title: UPDATE: No bond for woman accused in Saturday homicide
item.description: A Rocky Mount woman has been charged with murder after a Wilson man was found dead at a local motel. Police say the incident appears isolated and the investigation is ongoing.

item.title: Sims to unveil historical marker Saturday
item.description: Sims will unveil its first historical marker on Saturday, highlighting the town’s origins as a train depot. The event coincides with the annual Christmas tree lighting, featuring treats and photos with Santa.

item.title: ‘Air Doug’ gets biggest career win in 25th Thanksgiving Classic
item.description: Doug Barnes Jr. claimed his biggest career win at the 25th Thanksgiving Classic, charging from the rear to victory after missing qualifying, as Southern National Motorsports Park closed its 2025 season.

item.title: AREA ROUNDUP: Knights drub Burlington School in Hoopsgiving showdown
item.description: Greenfield School’s boys basketball team powered past The Burlington School 88-71 in the Hoopsgiving showcase, led by standout performances from Kobe Edwards and Braxten DuBose. Hunt High fell to Chapel Hill 63-45.

item.title: Church Advent Series resumes Wednesday
item.description: First Christian Church’s 16th annual Advent Series runs Wednesdays through Dec. 17, featuring free noon concerts with local vocalists and organists.

item.title: Brittle sentenced in fentanyl death of Mason Bennett
item.description: Claire Margaret Brittle was sentenced to up to 65 months in prison for supplying fentanyl that led to the death of Mason Scott Bennett, 22, in Wilson County.

item.title: Candidates file for office on opening day
item.description: Candidates filed for both Wilson County and state races as filing opened Monday.
